research.title: Ethical Fairness in Ubiquitous Health Sensing without Known Attributes
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Wearable and mobile sensing models infer health and well-being in everyday life, yet strong average performance can conceal failures for particular people, contexts, or devices. Existing fairness methods often require sensitive attributes during training, although such. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Exploring Student Perception on Gen AI Adoption in Higher Education: A Descriptive Study
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: The rapid proliferation of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) is reshaping pedagogical practices and assessment models in higher education. While institutional and educator perspectives on GenAI integration are increasingly documented, the student perspective remains comparatively underexplored. This. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: MetaCLASS: Metacognitive Coaching for Learning with Adaptive Self-regulation Support
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language models can generate fluent explanations, but effective tutoring requires supporting the learner's thought process, not just delivering content. Metacognitive tutoring targets this gap by prompting planning, monitoring, debugging, and evaluation, and, crucially, deciding when. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
